prayerExcerpt.en-US: Denying ourselves, we may hold fast to you with all our heart.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Renunciando a nós mesmos, possamos nos unir a vós de todo o coração.

meta.face: A man of about twenty-eight with a BROAD Slavic face, widest at the high, flat cheekbones and narrowing to a short, firm chin — a short, straight nose, light grey eyes set wide under level, fair-brown brows, a well-shaped mouth; straight chestnut hair cut level just below the ears (not long), a neat moustache and a short, small forked chestnut beard, and a clear, candid gaze toward the viewer; not Christ-like.
meta.basis: The fourteenth-century statue in his chapel in St. Vitus, attributed to Peter Parler (consulted), shows him young in armour with a moustache, a short forked beard and hair to the jaw, holding a lance and the eagle shield; he died about 935, aged under thirty.
